data.name: Dirgham
data.gender_notes: Dirgham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'dirghama' meaning 'heavy' or 'weighty'. In Islamic context, Dirgham refers to a heavy silver coin used as currency during the Islamic Golden Age. The name Dirgham carries the meaning “Heavy, weighty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dirgham usually hope their child will grow to embody heavy, weighty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Dirgham is believed to have a spiritual meaning of being grounded and strong in one's beliefs and values. It is a name that inspires courage and determination.
data.etymology: Dirgham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heavy, weighty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dirgham total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: دِرغَم
in_arabic.meaning: يُعني اسم دِرغَمُ قَولًا يُصادَفُ المُستَمِعُ مُدَّخرًا في قَلبي
in_arabic.long_meaning: أصل الكَلِمَة يأتي من الجُزء درجَماً وَهو مِن فَعَلَ درَجَ، وَهو مُشتَقٌّ مِن كَلِمَة درَجَ، وَمَعانِيَةُ الكَلِمَة هِيَ مُستَمِعُ المُتَكَلِّمِ مُقَبَلَهُ، وَهِيَ كَلِمَة تُشيرُ إِلَى المُستَمِعِ مُدَّخرًا في قَلبي، وَهِيَ مِنَ الأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي تُشيرُ إِلَى الحِفاظِ وَالإِحاطَةِ بِالمَعانِيَةِ، وَهِيَ مِنَ الأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي تَستَمعُ مِنَ اللَهِ خالِدًا

in_urdu.name: ڈرغم
in_urdu.meaning: یعنی ایک اسم جس کا مفہوم ایک چیز جسے سننے والا دل میں محفوظ کر لیتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اس نام کا ماخذ درجما سے ملا ہوا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں کہ کسی کو چھپا کر رکھنا، اور اس میں ہے کہ مومن جب کلام اللہ کو سنے تو اسے دل میں محفوظ کر لیتا ہے، اور اس طرح اللہ تعالیٰ کے کلام کو جسے سننے والا محفوظ رکھتا ہے

in_english.name: Dirgham
in_english.meaning: This name signifies the thing which one keeps in heart after hearing it
in_english.long_meaning: The name originates from the root word "daraja", which means 'to keep something concealed'. In the context of Islamic tradition, this name signifies the act of keeping Allah's words in one's heart, a practice that is considered a sign of faith and spiritual growth. It is a name that reflects the importance of listening to and retaining the divine message, and is often associated with individuals who possess strong willpower and determination.

data.cultural_impact: Dirgham was a significant symbol of economic progress and stability during the Islamic Golden Age. This coin played a crucial role in the development of a unified and efficient monetary system, which facilitated extensive trade networks throughout the Islamic world, contributing to the prosperity of the Islamic civilization as a whole.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Dirgham is also believed to hold spiritual significance. According to some scholars, the word 'dirghama' can be traced back to the Arabic phrase 'darrakah marfa'uha' which translates to 'a weight that causes growth.' Spiritually, Dirgham represents the idea that challenges and hardships in life can lead to growth and development, both as an individual and as a community. It is a reminder that the trials we face are an essential part of our spiritual journey towards self-improvement and enlightenment.
